draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Understood — I'll give you the week and won't crowd your evaluation. Good to know you're weighing whether Wrenfield fits the team.

One thing that often helps a decision: seeing it with more than one person in it. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's useful, I'm happy to walk through one next step with you whenever you're ready — just reply and I'll follow your lead.

Best,
Chidi
